div.head: I Cn Epilog
div.ab: [Á sy Godes nama ecelice gebletsod ⁊ lof him ⁊ wuldor ⁊ wurðmint symble æfre to worulde! Amen.]
Á sy Godes nama écelice gebletsod ⁊ lof him ⁊ wuldor ⁊ wurðmynt symble æfre to worulde! Amen.
Sit nomen Dei semper benedictum, cui laus, gloria et honor in eterna secula! Amen. (Cons. Cn.)
Á sy Godes nama écelice gebletsod ⁊ lof him ⁊ wuldor ⁊ wurðmynt symble æfre to worulde! Amen.
A sy Godes nama ecelice gebletsod, and lof him and wuldor and wurðmynt symble æfre to worulde. Amen.
Ever be the name of God eternally blessed, and praise and glory and honour be to Him for ever and ever. Amen.
May the name of God be sanctified forever, and praise and honor and glory be to him eternally. Amen.
(Epilog. Immer sei Gottes Name ewiglich gesegnet und Lob ihm und Ruhm und Ehre stets hinfüro in Ewigkeit! Amen. B Consil.)
(Epilogue. May God's name be blessed eternally for ever, and praise and glory and honour to him always, for ever and ever! Amen. B, Consiliatio)
div.note: In G, added in the 16th century in the margin (from B?), so given here bracketed in K. The epilogue is original (B, Consiliatio; similarly II Cn 84.5 and Wulfstan homilies 309, 191).; Robertson (p. 139) takes I Cn from B, which begins at ‘mæssedæg’ in 14.2, the earlier clauses being supplied from G
A . . . Amen: added in margin in a later hand in G; omitted A
